//: Solid compiles JSX into its own reactive calls with its own `JSX` namespace, so this
package is checked by ITS OWN config and is outside the repository's single program.
`jsx` and `jsxImportSource` are per-PROGRAM: a Solid component checked under React's
setting has every element typed as `React.JSX.Element` and rejects it. Both
`modules/bindings/solid` and `../_shared` say the same thing for the same reason.
